exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to cover, to screen, to close / shut softly
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: раскры́ть — to open; скрыть — to hide, to conceal; прикры́ть — to cover, to screen, to close / shut softly; покрыва́ть — to cover.
